Prevalence of dental caries at 5 years of age
cohort: 346 infants (179 boys and 167 girls) whose parents agreed to participate in a prospective medical study with a focus on growth and overweight prevention
finding: In this cohort, cesarean delivery was significantly associated with an increased risk of early childhood caries (ECC) at 5 years of age.
